name: Sri Venkateswara Steels ERP v2.8.8
notes: Official Release v2.8.8 for Sri Venkateswara Steels: - Clean Bill Photo Naming: Saved bill images strictly use '<InvoiceNo>_<DD-MM-YYYY>.<ext>' (e.g. Venus-123_10-11-2026.jpg) without 'Invoice_' prefix. - Single Image Storage: Exactly one image file is saved per invoice only upon form submission (preventing duplicate draft files). - Automatic conversion of existing legacy image files.
